name: Newmarket Highway 400 / East Gwillimbury Express
description: Highway 400 bus linking Newmarket, later East Gwillimbury, with North York. Its southern terminal changed from Yorkdale to Highway 407 Bus Terminal before the route was withdrawn.

timeline.event: The original timetable shows Newmarket Bus Terminal–Highway 9/400–Major Mackenzie/400–Yorkdale, with a Keele/401 branch.
Five weekday Newmarket–Yorkdale trips were added.
The documented northern terminus is East Gwillimbury GO; 66 and 66A still run to Yorkdale.
The documented route ends at Highway 407 Bus Terminal and uses the Davis/Eagle street stop in Newmarket.

gaps: The precise dates of the East Gwillimbury extension and Yorkdale-to-Highway-407 terminal change have not been pinned down; the dated timetables establish their presence.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
